question_text: Two charges 2 μC and −2 µC are placed at points A and B 6 cm apart. Identify an equipotential surface of the system. What is the direction of the electric field at every point on this surface?
answer_text: An equipotential surface is the plane on which total potential is zero everywhere. This plane is normal to line AB and is located at the mid-point of line AB because the magnitude of charges is the same. The direction of the electric field at every point on this surface is normal to the plane in the direction of AB.
final_answer: Thus, the equipotential surface is the plane at the midpoint of line AB.
